notes.subject: to Oholah and Oholibah (Samaria and Jerusalem)
notes.rationale: feminine-plural address closing the allegory's judgement speech

notes.subject: गुड़ाई-गिट्टन
notes.rationale: גלולים literally 'logs (round things)', rendered hyphen-joined for the wooden-idol picture; 'मूरति' would lose the log-shape

notes.subject: הני
notes.rationale: supplied हनी (honorific copula) for the recognition formula; Hebrew verbless clause

notes.subject: उठबइ
notes.rationale: נשא 'lift/carry' rendered as 'उठबइ' (bear-carry), keeping the load picture

translation: आउ ओकनी तोहनी के बुराइ तोहनी पर लेट देतन, आउ तोहनी अपन गुड़ाई-गिट्टन के पाप उठबइ; आउ तोहनी जानबइ कि हम अदोनाय यहवे हनी।
